questions.title: Which commodity category will record the largest monthly percentage price increase in the FAO Food Price Index for August 2026?
questions.background: The UN Food and Agriculture Organization (FAO) publishes a monthly index tracking international prices across major food commodity categories.
questions.resolution_criteria: Resolve to the commodity category with the largest percentage price increase from July to August 2026, as reported in the FAO's September 2026 Food Price Index release. Resolution Date: 2026-09-04 Answer with the category name.
questions.current_reasoning: With August trading effectively complete on 2026-08-31, end-of-month commodity summaries from Saxo (Aug 28) and Bloomberg / Daily Caller / NewsBytes (Aug 31) cement Sugar as the dominant FAO Food Price Index gainer for August ahead of Friday's Sept 4 release. Saxo explicitly calls sugar 'the standout performer, gaining close to 25% this month' and Bloomberg (Aug 31) reports New York raw sugar futures rose roughly 20% in August—their largest monthly gain since 2015—sustaining double-digit gains throughout the month (+19.47% MoM already by Aug 24) that translate directly into FAO's monthly-average ISA Sugar index. By contrast, grains rose ~13% overall (corn +15.6%, while wheat jumped +12.1% only in the final week after sitting -3.44% MoM through Aug 24), heavily damping FAO's full-month Cereals average alongside ~26%-weighted rice (~+1.7%); cocoa (~+20%) is excluded from the 5 FAO FFPI categories. Raising Sugar 0.86 -> 0.90 and trimming Cereals (0.08 -> 0.055), Vegetable Oils (0.04 -> 0.03), Dairy (0.01 -> 0.008), and Meat (0.01 -> 0.007) while retaining a 10% calibration buffer for July base-effect and physical FOB quote divergence (sum = 1.000).

questions.title: Which Southeast Asian country will declare a state of emergency over wildfire haze between September 1 and September 5, 2026?
questions.background: Seasonal wildfire smoke can cross borders in Southeast Asia, creating public-health risks and prompting emergency government responses.
questions.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : Official national government announcements, corroborated by reliable news reporting. Resolution Conditions : Resolve to the country whose national authorities announce a formal state of emergency because of wildfire haze between September 1 and September 5, 2026, inclusive. The declaration may cover the entire country or a specific area within it. Air-quality warnings, school closures, or health advisories without a formal emergency declaration do not qualify. Accepted Answer Format : The country’s common English name.
questions.current_reasoning: Major 2026-09-02 divergence narrows Malaysia's lead over Indonesia on Day 2 of the Sept 1-5 window (still no formal national state of emergency declared yet). Suharyanto are flying to Pontianak on Sept 3 for emergency talks while Greenpeace Indonesia publicly demanded national disaster emergency status ('tanggap darurat skala bencana nasional') amid ASEAN diplomatic protests (BBC Indonesia Sept 2). Malaysia stays favorite (0.76 -> 0.63) given NADMA Directive No. 1's explicit localized API-500 federal declaration trigger and the fresh West Kalimantan border hotspot surge that can blow north into Sarawak on Sept 3-4, while lifting Indonesia (0.20 -> 0.31). questions.background: The United States uses financial sanctions to restrict institutions accused of helping Iran access the international financial system.
